verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation includes Boxes for VMs and container tools (Podman/Toolbox) which could be used to create isolated test environments separate from production data, but there is no evidence of any AI-native testing workflow, dedicated sandbox tooling, or documentation describing this use case explicitly. missing for 10: AI-specific sandbox/testing workflow, explicit documentation of isolating test from production data, independent corroboration of this use case.
